title: Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer (Python, SQL) £38K - £42.5K

Coventry based - Hybrid working - 4 days onsite working

I'm currently working with an established retail business that's investing heavily in its data function and is looking to add a Data Engineer to the team.

This is a great opportunity to join a business where you'll play a key role in developing and maintaining data solutions that support business-critical decision making across the organisation. You'll be working closely with a collaborative team, helping to build robust data pipelines, improve data quality and deliver reliable reporting and insights.

What they're looking for:
  • Strong experience with Python, SQL and Excel
  • Experience building and maintaining ETL/data pipelines
  • Knowledge of data modelling and database design
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Nice to have:
  • Azure (Data Factory, Synapse, Databricks or similar)
  • Power BI
  • Git or Azure DevOps
  • Experience working with cloud-based data platforms
  • Exposure to retail, eCommerce or customer data

This is a 4 days per week onsite position based in Coventry, offering the chance to work within a supportive team that's genuinely investing in its data capabilities.


Please apply asap if interested. GleeIT

At Gleeson Recruitment Group, we embrace inclusivity and welcome applicants of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities. We are proud to be a disability confident employer.

By applying you will be registered as a candidate with Gleeson Recruitment Limited. Our Privacy Policy is available on our website and explains how we will use your data.
